args.summary: The v2.3.1 production deployment of checkout-api failed health checks with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Mitigation: performed a rollback in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release confirmed healthy in production (v2.3.0 was the last healthy production deployment; the only intermediate release, v2.3.1-rc, was staging-only and was also unhealthy). Rollback completed and verified: v2.3.0 is now running in all regions with health restored and error rate down to ~0.2%. Incident opened after mitigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified.

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed in all three regions and unhealthy with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified rollback target**: From the deployment history, **v2.3.0** was the most recent release healthy in production (the only release after it besides v2.3.1 was a staging-only rc, also unhealthy — so no change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in prod).
3. **Rolled back** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0 — the rollout verified successfully, and the service is now healthy with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery; the on-call engineer has been paged.
